sources.label: PowerAdSpy home
sources.claim: PowerAdSpy positions itself as an AI-powered competitive ad intelligence platform indexing ads across 100+ countries on 11 networks including Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Google, and TikTok.

sources.label: PowerAdSpy pricing
sources.claim: PowerAdSpy lists Standard at $99/month, Platinum at $279/month, and Palladium at $399/month on monthly billing, with 3-day paid trials and roughly 50–70% off on yearly billing.
